---
title: "Seasons"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
```

```{r}
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  count(month, month_num) |>
  arrange(month_num)
```

```{r}
summary(mallards$speed)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  filter(!is.na(speed), speed <= 30) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = fct_reorder(month, month_num))) +
  geom_density_ridges() +
  labs(
    x = "Speed (m/s)",
    y = "Month",
    title = "Mallard speed distributions by month"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
